title: Elementary exact-derived exchange pasting
statement: For arbitrary commutative vertically pasted scheme squares, exact derived proper base change commutes with the canonical right-derived direct-image compositor. For Cartesian squares of open immersions, inverse exact derived open base change commutes with the descended extension-by-zero compositor. Exact base change along the two identity direct images commutes with their canonical identity normalizations. No quasi-compactness is required. The definitions and input factors are [lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting], [lem-asd-open-base-change-unit-mate], [lem-cbc-extension-zero-composition].

source.place: Tags 0F7F and 0F7J; explicit normalization and factor pasting in lem-route-exists-right-derived-lower-shriek-comp-iso

proof.text: Derive the inverse-image compositors and their associative and unital coherence. Bundle them as the pullback part of a compact-support formalism, with right-derived proper adjoints and exact open extension adjoints.
The exact exchange is the mate of the derived inverse-image square. Proper composition is its conjugate. Apply vertical mate pasting and cancel inverse compositor factors.
For open extension, verify that the descended compositor is the conjugate under the descended composite adjunction. Apply the open mate-pasting theorem and invert the open exchange factors.

Normalize the identity adjunction by the derived identity functor comparison. Conjugation gives the specified proper identity comparison, and the identity mate equation gives its exchange normalization.

proof_origin.place: R9: explicit factorwise proof of the parent graph compositor argument, retaining ordinary unbounded categories and the original hypotheses.

lean.statement:
theorem sfExactExchangePasting :
    (∀
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (t : X' ⟶ X)
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A X) ,
    D((t)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).map
        ((rightDerivedLowerStarIdIso A X).hom.app K) =
      (exactDerivedBaseChangeMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        (show CommSq t (𝟙 X') (𝟙 X) t from ⟨by simp⟩)).app K ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerStarIdIso A X').hom.app
        (D((t)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj K)) ∧
    (∀
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {U U' V V' Z Z' : Scheme.{u}}
    {t : U' ⟶ U} {m : V' ⟶ V} {b : Z' ⟶ Z}
    {l₁ : U' ⟶ V'} {r₁ : U ⟶ V} {l₂ : V' ⟶ Z'} {r₂ : V ⟶ Z}
    (sq₁ : CommSq t l₁ r₁ m) (sq₂ : CommSq m l₂ r₂ b)
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A U) ,
    D((b)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).map
        ((rightDerivedLowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) r₁ r₂).hom.app K) ≫
      (exactDerivedBaseChangeMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        (sq₁.vert_comp sq₂)).app K =
    (exactDerivedBaseChangeMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) sq₂).app
        (R((r₁)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj K) ≫
      R((l₂)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).map
        ((exactDerivedBaseChangeMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) sq₁).app K) ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) l₁ l₂).hom.app
        (D((t)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj K)) ∧
    (∀
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {U U' V V' Z Z' : Scheme.{u}}
    {t : U' ⟶ U} {m : V' ⟶ V} {b : Z' ⟶ Z}
    {l₁ : U' ⟶ V'} {r₁ : U ⟶ V} {l₂ : V' ⟶ Z'} {r₂ : V ⟶ Z}
    [IsOpenImmersion l₁] [IsOpenImmersion r₁]
    [IsOpenImmersion l₂] [IsOpenImmersion r₂]
    (sq₁ : IsPullback t l₁ r₁ m) (sq₂ : IsPullback m l₂ r₂ b)
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A U) ,
    D((b)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).map
        ((mapDerivedCategoryOpenImmersionLowerShriekComp
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) r₁ r₂).inv.app K) ≫
      (mapDerivedCategoryOpenImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeIso
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (sq₁.paste_vert sq₂)).inv.app K =
    (mapDerivedCategoryOpenImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeIso
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) sq₂).inv.app
        (D((r₁)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj K) ≫
      D((l₂)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).map
        ((mapDerivedCategoryOpenImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeIso
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) sq₁).inv.app K) ≫
      (mapDerivedCategoryOpenImmersionLowerShriekComp
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) l₁ l₂).inv.app
        (D((t)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj K))
